parsed.main_gap: The proof that a nonunit always remains uses a false general inference, though the gap is immediately repairable by observing that every legal move outputs at least one nonunit.

errors.description: A positive nonincreasing integer sequence can reach zero. Instead, note directly that a legal move selects two nonunits and produces at least one nonunit: if gcd>1, the gcd is nonunit; if gcd=1, the second output is mn>1.
errors.quote: A nonnegative integer that never increases and starts at a positive value can never reach \(0\); hence \(K\ge1\) at every stage

parsed.notes: The termination descent and primewise valuation-gcd invariant are otherwise correct and establish the claimed formula. The sole logical gap is small and straightforwardly repaired from calculations already present.
